name: 字林西报大楼 / 友邦大厦
coordinateSystem: glTF x east, y up, z south; origin at OSM footprint centroid and ground; rotation already baked
sourceLicense: OSM derived geometry ODbL-1.0, attribution OpenStreetMap contributors
geometryStatus: Architectural interpretation from attributed reference photographs; footprint measured from OSM; not a measured heritage survey
observedMainFacadeLevels: 2 rusticated lower floors + 5 middle rows + recessed attic loggia + twin opaque square roof towers with low curved crowns
heightStatus: 40 m is a photo-proportioned working estimate, not a verified or surveyed height. Public search snippets with more precise numbers were not accepted as primary evidence.
facadeStructure: Narrow riverfront with two wider wing axes, narrow central openings and a triplet; 24 independently photo-mapped windows with solid primary bars; fluted lower columns, simplified relief and atlantes; dark recessed attic loggia; twin opaque stone towers, paired columns, deep apertures, layered square cornices, low curved crowns and forward pediments.

coverage.detailLimit: Street-facing recognizable details follow photographs; hidden rear openings and many vertical dimensions remain estimates.

photo_texture.author: Suicasmo
photo_texture.scope: 24 individually mapped recessed glazing fronts among25 reviewed; lowest centre omitted because a carved stone plaque occludes the photograph. No photo is projected onto a whole facade plane.

asset_license: MIT (original model); CC0-1.0 (photographic samples); retain ODbL-1.0 attribution for the OSM footprint
current_detail_note: 原1,148个结构石墙盒按7组同平面墙厚重建为共形并集，清除内部重叠侧面和T接缝，保留真窗洞及内退。逐窗核对25个中部大窗，其中24窗使用真实照片，最低中央窗因浮雕遮挡保留原材质；内部框条按照片细化，重复石条合并。双塔为厚实体、四根前柱、深暗开口、层叠方檐和低浅弧顶，前移山花；顶层后退窗改暗内景。约40m高度、未见侧后和细小雕饰仍有推定。
vertex_count_basis: Sum of distinct current GLB POSITION accessor counts; includes split normal/UV vertices.
